fairness.hunterKnowledgePolicy: Default self-play rejects omniscient Hunter strategies. Hunter planning uses public priors, scheduled observations, and generated phantom Runner plans.

hunterKnowledgeModels.belief: Hunter scores against a generated phantom Runner prior/replan observation and never reads the real future steps during planning.

runner.label: Runner multimodal beam
runner.notes: Searches rail, walking, flights, ships, and any loaded buses for a long escape plan.

runner.label: Runner wait 10 then multimodal
runner.notes: Waits until 06:10, then runs the multimodal escape search.

runner.label: Runner wait 20 then multimodal
runner.notes: Gives Hunter less early signal by holding Tokyo until 06:20 before escaping.

runner.label: Runner rail one leg
runner.notes: Takes the best single rail escape leg from Tokyo.

runner.label: Runner rail three legs
runner.notes: Extends the rail escape by repeatedly planning from each tail station.

hunter.label: Hunter rail one leg
hunter.notes: Releases at 06:30 and plans one rail intercept leg against a phantom Runner generated from public information.

hunter.label: Hunter rail two legs
hunter.notes: Releases at 06:30 and chains two rail intercept plans against a phantom Runner generated from public information.

hunter.label: Hunter rail three legs
hunter.notes: Releases at 06:30 and chains three rail intercept plans against a phantom Runner generated from public information.

hunter.label: Hunter multimodal static
hunter.notes: Releases at 06:30 and runs one multimodal intercept beam search against a phantom Runner generated from public information.

hunter.label: Hunter multimodal replan
hunter.notes: Releases at 06:30, runs multimodal intercept search, then replans hourly from observations without reading Runner future steps.

hunter.label: Hunter belief static
hunter.notes: Plans against a phantom Runner generated from public start information, not the real future plan.

hunter.label: Hunter belief replan
hunter.notes: Holds Tokyo until the first 07:00 observation, then replans hourly from observed Runner state without reading future steps.

hunter.label: Hunter hold Tokyo
hunter.notes: Releases at 06:30 but holds Tokyo as a control baseline.
